'''Xucphra Corporate Headquarters''' was a building in [[Xucphra City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. It served as the main headquarters for the [[Xucphra Corporation]].<ref name="BW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
